Senior Product Controller (London)

About Keyrock

Founded in 2017, Keyrock is a leading digital asset market maker with 200+ team members globally, representing 42 nationalities. We trade across 80+ exchanges and run desks in market making, options, OTC, and DeFi. We’re known for our tech-first approach, Rust-based trading systems, and for actively shaping the future of digital asset markets.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Role Overview

Working in the Finance Team, as a Senior Product Controller, you will be the primary evaluator of the performance of the firm's trading desks and digital product lines. You will ensure the accuracy of financial reporting, manage valuation risks, and provide strategic insights into the profitability of our digital assets and financial products. You’ll bridge the gap between complex front-office trading activities and back-office financial reporting. This is an opportunity to enhance the existing processes to improve the quality, accuracy, timeliness and independence of the function.

Key Responsibilities

  • P&L Production & Analysis: Deliver daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly, Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting. Provide deep-dive commentary on drivers, including market movements, costs and new trade activity.

  • Position Substantiation: Verify the integrity of the businesses trading positions ensuring all digital assets positions are accurately recorded and reconciled.

  • Independent Price Verification (IPV): Lead the valuation process by checking internal marks against independent market data.

  • Compensation Accrual: Ensuring compensation accrual is both accurate and dynamic, as the P&L moves over time. Managing changes as and when required.

  • Process Automation: Identify inefficiencies in manual reporting and collaborate with Engineering/Data teams to automate workflows.

  • Control Framework: Maintain a robust internal control environment to mitigate operational risk, specifically regarding trade lifecycle events in a 24/7 digital market. Manage accounting policies to support the valuations and revenue recognition.

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as a key advisor to Traders, Portfolio Managers, and Senior Finance leadership regarding margin trends and capital requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 5–8 years in Product Control, Middle Office, or Audit within a financial institution (Fintech, Crypto, or Investment Banking experience preferred). Dealing with revenue producers

  • Technical Savvy: Proficiency in Excel/GSheets is a given, but experience with programming language and utilising AI, is beneficial.

  • Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of financial products (Derivatives, Fixed Income, or Digital Assets/Tokens).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics. Professional designations (CPA, CFA, or ACCA) are a major plus.

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary package

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

We’re looking for a Senior Credit Risk Portfolio Manager

About us

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to more than 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

We combine cutting-edge technology and data science with genuine human understanding to make finance feel less like a barrier and more like a superpower. Whether it's managing cash flow or seizing unexpected opportunities, we ensure businesses get the funds they need – often within minutes.

The role - Shape the future of small business lending

At iwoca, we’re on a mission to expand access to finance for small businesses. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a sharp, experienced Senior Credit Risk Portfolio Manager for our German business. This role is central to maintaining our strong credit risk culture and ensuring we scale responsibly and sustainably.

You'll work closely with our Chief Credit Officer, Data Scientists, Capital Markets team, and other stakeholders across the business. Your insights will directly influence credit policy, risk appetite, funding strategy, and our ability to serve more customers with confidence.

What you will be doing:

  • Own the portfolio: Monitor credit performance across the DE portfolio—by product, segment, and risk tier. Spot trends early and drive corrective action.

  • Be the voice of credit risk: Provide clear, concise reporting on loss rates and credit profile to the Risk Committee and senior leadership.

  • Support strategic direction: Help shape and manage iwoca’s credit risk appetite and credit policy.

  • Inform funding strategy: Work with Capital Markets to produce compelling, data-driven risk insights for investors. Ensure we meet performance triggers and concentration limits across funding facilities.
    Cross-functional leadership: Bring credit risk expertise to major business initiatives and multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Lead the team: Set a clear agenda for your team, coach and develop talent, and ensure high-quality, impactful delivery.

The requirements

  • A strong analytical mind: A background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a similarly quantitative field—or equivalent experience.

  • Credit risk expertise: 3+ years in a credit risk role at a traditional or fintech lender.

  • Data-driven problem-solver: Skilled at both framing problems conceptually and executing technical analysis. Hands-on with Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and SQL.

  • Bonus points for experience with Monte Carlo simulations, PyMC3, and Bayesian modeling.

  • Confident communicator: Able to turn complex analysis into clear, actionable insight for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • People leader: Experience managing analysts or small teams with a focus on coaching and professional development.

  • Execution-focused: Able to structure and drive work forward independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 for this role, But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we look to hire smart, passionate, humble individuals with a growth mindset. We prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members.

We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.

Our friendly and inclusive environment, combined with our flexible work policies, ensures that you'll have the perfect balance between work and life, empowering you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a brilliant place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks

  • Events and clubs, like bingo, comedy nights, yoga classes, football, etc.

The benefits (depending on your location)

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • 25 days’ holiday, an extra day off for your birthday, and the option to buy or sell an additional 5 days of annual leave.

  • Instant access to emotional and mental health support with our partner, Spill.

  • Pension and share options.

  • Generous maternity and paternity leave.

  • A nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Paid volunteering day to support your chosen charity.

  • Unlimited unpaid leave.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme and electric car scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year, we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain and further afield.

  • Private GP service for you, your partner, and your dependents.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse if you want to learn to code.

About the Role

You will architect, build, and scale the internal technology ecosystem that accelerates workforce productivity, eliminates operational friction, and gives the company a compounding infrastructure advantage. You will treat internal tools with the same product rigour and user-centricity as any external product — because the quality of internal systems directly determines organisational velocity.

You will lead a cross-functional engineering team, make high-stakes build-vs-buy decisions, and drive AI adoption into internal workflows. This role requires someone who can see the company’s operational architecture as a system design problem and solve it with software.

What You Will Do

Internal Platform Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for all internal tools, platforms, and automation — treating internal technology as a product, not a cost centre.

  • Make strategic build-vs-buy decisions, knowing when a custom-built solution creates a lasting advantage and when a SaaS tool is the right answer.

  • Map current and next-state process flows across the entire internal toolchain and lead systems transformation for internal teams.

Systems Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and maintain the full engineering lifecycle for internal platforms — from ideation and design through deployment, iteration, and deprecation.

  • Build seamless, API-first ecosystems that integrate internal tools across HR systems, finance platforms, knowledge management, CRM, and developer infrastructure.

  • Own system reliability and operational resilience: establish success metrics for uptime, performance, and employee productivity.

  • Design scalable, secure architectures using cloud-native principles, microservices, and modern integration patterns.

AI & Automation

  • Lead the strategy for integrating AI and LLMs into internal workflows — reimagining how knowledge is shared, decisions are supported, and work is executed across the organisation.

  • Deploy intelligent automation tools — including AI where appropriate — to streamline internal processes and improve decision-making.

  • Evaluate and integrate AI-assisted troubleshooting, proactive recommendations, and intelligent automation into the internal platform layer.

  • Stay ahead of technology trends and drive continuous experimentation — you build prototypes, not slide decks.

Developer Experience & Productivity

  • Reduce cognitive load for internal users by providing golden paths, standardised workflows, and self-service capabilities.

  • Ensure frictionless onboarding and seamless integration across the tool ecosystem.

  • Measure platform success through adoption rates, user satisfaction, DORA metrics, and productivity impact — not feature count.

Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of engineers and engineering managers.

  • Cultivate a collaborative engineering culture rooted in ownership, speed, and craftsmanship.

  • Provide technical mentorship and create growth paths for individual contributors and managers alike.

  • Foster psychological safety and a feedback-driven environment that empowers people to do their best work.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with People, Finance, Engineering, Legal, and Operations leadership to translate complex business needs into a unified technical vision.

  • Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and the engineering team — you speak both languages fluently.

  • Align internal platform investments with broader company strategy and demonstrate measurable ROI.

What You Will Need

Must-Have

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership (managing teams or managing managers).

  • Strong hands-on technical background: you’ve built production systems and can still credibly review architecture, code, and system design.

  • Deep understanding of cloud-based systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure), APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and modern infrastructure.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling internal tools or platforms that serve cross-functional business teams — not just engineering.

  • Experience making build-vs-buy decisions and managing a portfolio of custom-built and third-party tools.

  • Strong experience designing and building internal platforms and automation systems

  • Strong product thinking: you define success in terms of user outcomes and business impact, not technical output.

  • Experience navigating the full SDLC from ideation through deprecation — you know when to build, iterate, and retire.

  • Excellent communication skills: you can articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical executives and translate business problems into engineering roadmaps.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience at a high-growth technology or AI-native company that scaled rapidly.

  • Background in platform engineering, developer experience, or internal developer platforms (IDPs).

  • Familiarity with HRIS, ERP, and business systems integration (Workday, Salesforce, NetSuite, etc.).

  • Experience with cybersecurity best practices and compliance frameworks for internal systems.

  • Prior experience leading internal technology through M&A integrations or multi-entity consolidation.

  • Exposure to knowledge management systems, internal search, and enterprise AI assistants.

  • Experience integrating AI/LLMs into internal workflows or productivity tools

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 30 days: Completed a full audit of the existing internal toolchain, identified the top friction points, and presented a prioritised roadmap.

  • Within 60 days: Shipped at least two high-impact internal tools or automations that measurably improve productivity, and established team operating rhythm.

  • Within 12 months: The internal tools ecosystem is a recognised competitive advantage — teams actively request new capabilities, AI is embedded in daily workflows, and internal NPS is consistently high.

Who You Are

An engineer who thinks like a CEO. You’ve built production systems, led engineering teams, and understand that the best internal tools don’t just save time — they change how an organisation thinks and moves. You’re obsessed with removing friction, allergic to manual workarounds, and energised by the idea that great internal infrastructure compounds into organisational speed. You believe internal tools deserve the same craft as customer-facing products. You see AI not as a buzzword but as the most important lever for internal productivity in a generation, and you want to be the person who pulls it.

How We Work

We operate as a small, senior, hands-on team. Engineers own features end-to-end — from design discussion through production monitoring.

Code reviews and design reviews are expected for all meaningful changes. We discuss architecture openly, make decisions quickly, and ship frequently.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, the process to offer may be shorter.

As a Loan Officer on our retail team, you'll be the trusted guide for real-estate investors and entrepreneurs seeking eDSCR (electronic Debt Service Coverage Ratio) and other business-purpose mortgages. This isn't a typical loan-officer role; you will leverage AHL's AI platform and digital DSCR workflow to identify qualified borrowers and deliver clear approvals in days, not weeks. Your focus will be on direct borrower relationships, combining your expertise and experience to deliver value to borrowers.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow a retail investor pipeline. Prospect and nurture relationships with real-estate investors and small-business owners, and maintain a network of referral partners such as realtors and accountants.

  • Use predictive analytics and AI tools to qualify borrowers. Our platform helps you identify high-potential prospects and pre-populate applications, so you can focus on advising rather than data entry.

  • Explain loan options and terms clearly. Guide borrowers through DSCR, bridge and other non-QM products, explaining how qualifying based on property earnings can be advantageous.

  • Deliver outstanding client service. Build rapport, respond to questions promptly, provide regular updates and maintain an active pipeline that meets or exceeds production goals.

  • Provide feedback to our product team. Participate in feedback loops to refine our AI underwriting and digital workflow.

You'll Excel Here If You…

  • Thrive on relationships and results, and are excited to use technology to scale both.

  • Understand DSCR and business-purpose lending but want tools that eliminate friction from the process.

  • Are energized by data-driven selling and appreciate the power of AI to personalize outreach and identify the right opportunities.

  • Think like an investor: ROI, time-to-close and flexibility matter. You advise clients as if each deal were your own.

  • Embrace innovation and adapt quickly — you're curious and eager to be part of the mortgage industry's AI transformation.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience originating residential or commercial mortgages; DSCR or non-QM experience is strongly preferred.

  • Active NMLS license and a track record of complying with federal and state lending regulations.

  • Deep knowledge of DSCR, bridge, fix-and-flip and other investor-focused products.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using AI tools, CRMs and digital communication platforms.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to build trust with sophisticated investors as well as first-time landlords.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical ability; able to interpret DSCR ratios, cap rates and other real-estate metrics.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, real estate or a related field, or equivalent experience would be preferred.

Why AHL

  • AI as your growth partner. Streamline lead qualification, pricing and communication using our proprietary AI platform.

  • Speed is your advantage. Our AI underwriting reduces turnaround times by up to 80% and our digital DSCR program aims for five-day closings.

  • Human + machine synergy. We amplify, not replace — your expertise remains at the center of each loan.

  • Remote flexibility. Work from anywhere and access a unified digital dashboard with real-time insights.

  • Frontier industry growth. Be part of the first wave of AI-native mortgage lending.

  • Investor-minded culture. We think like investors because we serve investors.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid/remote role that leverages digital platforms to enhance daily performance. You'll collaborate virtually with a multidisciplinary team, engage borrowers across the country.
